source.prompt: Instrumental background music for a classic 1990s-style Japanese fantasy role-playing game. The writing and orchestration evoke the golden age of 16-bit console RPG soundtracks (memorable singable lead melody, clear bass line, warm chords, tasteful hall reverb), but the production is high quality, warm and full, recorded with real-sounding instruments. Completely original melody. The game's world lives in an endless night lit by lanterns, lamps and great beacon fires; the score is gentle and melancholic, with warmth and a quiet, stubborn hope. A battle theme for defending a snowed-in village gate at night against a pack of ice wolves in a blizzard, the festival fire burning behind the defenders. Urgent, brave and determined rather than grim; a clear heroic brass melody over pounding drums. Tempo 144 BPM, 4/4 time, key of C minor. Instrumentation: driving low strings ostinato, war taiko and frame drums, horn calls, a heroic brass melody, fiddle tremolo like a blizzard, occasional wolf-howl-like string glissandi. Form: horn call and drum intro; section A brass melody over string ostinato; section B tense minor-key fiddle tremolo with horn answers; section A returns bigger; the last bar leads back to section A. Duration: 85 seconds. Instrumental only: no vocals, no singing, no spoken words, no lyrics. Keep one steady tempo and key from start to finish, no fade-in and no fade-out, no long silences; the last bar leads naturally back into the first bar so the piece loops seamlessly as game background music.
